checks.scenario: switching tasks leaves inactive source panel inert; new file owns its only Find panel

boundary: Normal packaged App, two own real PTYs running existing input-only Python receiver, no model/eval/subprocess of terminal input. Actual pointer/keyboard Find and existing keyboard-accessible GoToLine button; no invented unconfirmed global GoToLine accelerator. Original source/selection/UI and native input bytes observed read-only. Native Mac uses Meta-F; Control-F separately tested only in owned editor as App branch. ShadowRoot topology has separate component/browser evidence, normal App has no such file route. No daily paths/credentials/clipboard/external actions.
